host.description: Host address of the MySQL/MariaDB database.

port.description: Port number to use for connection. Honors $MYSQL_TCP_PORT.

user.description: User name to connect to the database.

socket.description: The socket file to use for connection. If empty, TCP/IP is used.

password.description: Password to connect to the database.

database.description: Database to use. If empty, mycli starts without a default database.

logfile.description: Filename to log every query and its results to.

defaults_file.description: Path to a specific defaults file. Empty for standard locations.

login_path.description: Login path to read credentials from the MySQL login file.
